summary: Completed and verified. In Dashboard settings > General (Time options) the "Auto refresh" intervals field was prefilled with this build's default "5s,10s,30s,1m,5m,15m,30m,1h,2h,1d"; entering that exact value left the save drawer showing "No changes to save" with Save disabled, so nothing would have persisted — I therefore made a genuine edit to "5s,10s,30s,1m,2m,5m,15m,30m,1h,2h,1d" (keeps 1m, adds 2m) and saved via "Save dashboard" → Save, which returned "Dashboard saved". I then hard-reloaded the bare dashboard URL and confirmed on the live DOM: the saved JSON model is now version 4 with "timepicker": {"refresh_intervals": ["5s","10s","30s","1m","2m","5m","15m","30m","1h","2h","1d"]} (includes "1m"; before the save it was version 3 with "timepicker": {}), and the top-bar refresh picker menu lists "Off Auto 5s 10s 30s 1m 2m 5m 15m 30m 1h 2h 1d", so 1m is offered as an interval. The previously persisted "bench" tag and now-6h default range are intact in the same model, and the dashboard shows both panels ("fwgr71-n1 Notes", "fwgr71-n1 Availability"). Final browser page URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efz7k3zis3hmoc/fwgr71-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser
